talents.name: Opportunist (Agent Key)
talents.summary: Once per round, after you roll the plot die, you may reroll it — but you're stuck with the new result.

talents.name: Get ’Em Talking
talents.summary: Spend 1 focus: Deduction vs. a target's Spiritual defense. Success reveals why they're in the scene; for the rest of the scene you can raise the stakes on tests that exploit that motivation.

talents.name: Watchful Eye
talents.summary: When a willing ally within 20 ft. rolls a plot die, you can spend your reaction to let them use your Opportunist reroll.

talents.name: Quick Analysis
talents.summary: Spend 2 focus to gain an extra action usable only for cognitive tests (Use a Skill, Gain Advantage, or an Agent talent action). In conversations/endeavors it can be an extra contribution instead.

talents.name: Baleful
talents.summary: Anyone resisting your influence must pay extra focus equal to your tier.

talents.name: Gather Evidence
talents.summary: Whenever you succeed on a cognitive test against someone, you're Focused until the end of your next turn. Grants the Legal Codes expertise.

talents.name: Hardy
talents.summary: +1 max (and current) health per character level, applied retroactively and going forward.

talents.name: Sleuth’s Instincts
talents.summary: Advantage on cognitive tests against anyone whose motivation you know, and you automatically notice when such a person lies to you (not what the lie is).

talents.name: Close the Case
talents.summary: Once per scene, 3 focus: Deduction vs. Cognitive (advantage if you know their motivation, disadvantage if not). Success makes them back down from opposing you this scene; failure gives them advantage against you until their next turn ends. Resisting costs them a disadvantage on everything until their next turn ends.

talents.name: Sure Outcome
talents.summary: When you use Opportunist you may instead pay 2 focus to set the plot die: a Complication becomes a blank 4, and a blank becomes an Opportunity.

talents.name: Plausible Excuse
talents.summary: Reaction when caught skulking: spend 2 focus to sell an innocent excuse to everyone who can sense you. Those who resist lose extra focus equal to your Deception ranks. Grants Sleight of Hand expertise.

talents.name: Risky Behavior
talents.summary: Before any test, spend 1 focus to raise the stakes on it.

talents.name: Cheap Shot
talents.summary: With a free hand, 1 focus: unarmed Thievery attack vs. Cognitive on a same-size-or-smaller enemy, stakes raised. Hit = Stunned until their next turn ends; on a hit or graze you can spend an Opportunity to lift an unheld item.

talents.name: Collected
talents.summary: +2 to both Cognitive and Spiritual defense.

talents.name: Cover Story
talents.summary: You establish a fleshed-out false identity (agree its details and reputation with the GM) and gain a cultural expertise that fits it.

talents.name: Double Down
talents.summary: After using Opportunist you may reroll the plot die one more time; you must keep that final roll, and if it shows a Complication you lose 2 focus.

talents.name: Surefooted
talents.summary: +10 ft. movement. Damage from falling or dangerous terrain is reduced by 2 × your tier.

talents.name: Subtle Takedown
talents.summary: Unarmed Insight attack vs. Cognitive against a same-size-or-smaller target who is Surprised, can't sense you, or doesn't see you as a threat; stakes raised. On a hit they can't communicate until their next turn ends, and an Opportunity lets you auto-Grapple them (they're also Prone while grappled).

talents.name: Mighty
talents.summary: Weapon/unarmed hits deal +(1 + tier) damage for each action spent on that attack.

talents.name: Underworld Contacts
talents.prereq_text: Have a patron or follower who is a member of the criminal underworld; Double Down talent
requires_other: Have a patron or follower who is a member of the criminal underworld
talents.summary: Before a social test with criminals, spend 2 focus to add an Opportunity. Grants Criminal Groups expertise.

talents.name: Shadow Step
talents.summary: After you Disengage, spend 2 focus to test Thievery vs. the Cognitive of every enemy who can sense you (advantage in cover or obscured areas); you become hidden from each one you beat.

talents.name: Mercurial Facade
talents.summary: Disguise yourself with Deception instead of Thievery, even with no physical disguise kit. The first person who sees through it — or whom you surprise with a reveal — is Surprised until your next turn ends.

talents.name: High Society Contacts
talents.prereq_text: Have a patron who is part of high society; Cover Story talent
requires_other: Have a patron who is part of high society
talents.summary: When interacting socially in high society, spend 2 focus to add an Opportunity. Grants High Society expertise.

talents.name: Fast Talker
talents.summary: Spend 2 focus to gain an extra action usable only for spiritual tests (Use a Skill, Gain Advantage, or an Agent talent action). In conversations/endeavors it can be an extra contribution instead.

talents.name: Trickster’s Hand
talents.summary: Spend 2 focus to gain an extra action usable only for physical tests (Use a Skill, Gain Advantage, or an Agent talent action). In conversations/endeavors it can be an extra contribution instead.

talents.name: Rousing Presence (Envoy Key)
talents.summary: Make an ally you can influence Determined until they use it or the scene ends (Determined: add an Opportunity to a failed test).

talents.name: Steadfast Challenge
talents.summary: 1 focus: Discipline vs. an enemy's Spiritual defense. Success leaves them Disoriented and at a disadvantage against you until their next turn ends.

talents.name: Collected
talents.summary: +2 to both Cognitive and Spiritual defense.

talents.name: Withering Retort
talents.summary: Reaction before someone attacks you: use Steadfast Challenge on them, and add your Discipline ranks to your deflect against that attack.

talents.name: Well Dressed
talents.summary: While visibly wearing Presentable armor or fashionable clothes, gain advantage on your first Deception, Leadership, or Persuasion test each scene. Grants Fashion expertise.

talents.name: Calm Appeal
talents.summary: When Steadfast Challenge Disorients someone, spend 1 focus to pacify them for the scene (no hostile acts unless they or their allies are attacked/injured). Those who resist your Challenge lose extra focus equal to your Discipline ranks.

talents.name: High Society Contacts
talents.prereq_text: Have a patron who is part of high society; Well Dressed talent
requires_other: Have a patron who is part of high society
talents.summary: When interacting socially in high society, spend 2 focus to add an Opportunity. Grants High Society expertise.

talents.name: Peaceful Solution
talents.summary: If every non-minion enemy is pacified and everyone else agrees, you end the combat and it becomes a conversation (GM may allow outside combat too).

talents.name: Practiced Oratory
talents.summary: When using Rousing Presence or Steadfast Challenge, spend focus (up to your Persuasion ranks) to add that many extra targets.

talents.name: Customary Garb
talents.summary: While visibly wearing Presentable armor or clothing suited to your station, +2 Physical and Spiritual defense.

talents.name: Galvanize
talents.summary: Once per scene, an ally you can influence rolls their recovery die and regains that much focus.

talents.name: Sound Advice
talents.summary: Reaction when an ally you can influence fails a skill test: spend 1 focus to use Rousing Presence on them.

talents.name: Practical Demonstration
talents.summary: After you succeed on an attack or Gain Advantage test, use Rousing Presence as a free action.

talents.name: Devoted Presence
talents.summary: When you use Rousing Presence, pay 1 focus per target to also clear Prone, Slowed, Stunned, and/or Surprised.

talents.name: Composed
talents.summary: +focus equal to your tier (max and current), growing as your tier rises.

talents.name: Lessons in Patience
talents.summary: Each target of your Rousing Presence also regains 1 focus. Grants Motivational Speech expertise.

talents.name: Mighty
talents.summary: Weapon/unarmed hits deal +(1 + tier) damage for each action spent on that attack.

talents.name: Stalwart Presence
talents.summary: When you use Rousing Presence, spend 1 focus to give the target +2 to one defense of your choice until the end of next round.

talents.name: Applied Motivation
talents.summary: Whenever you make someone recover focus, they recover extra focus equal to half your Lore ranks (round up).

talents.name: Instill Confidence
talents.prereq_text: Have a companion; Lessons in Patience talent
talents.summary: Your Rousing Presence can make the target Focused for the rest of the scene instead of Determined.

talents.name: Guiding Oration
talents.summary: After a successful Gain Advantage, pick an ally within 10 ft. of the target; they get advantage on their next test against that target (until their next turn ends).

talents.name: Sage Counsel
talents.summary: After you Aid an ally, spend 1 focus to also give them your Rousing Presence for free.

talents.name: Inspired Zeal
talents.prereq_text: Discipline 3+; either Applied Motivation talent or Stalwart Presence talent
talents.summary: When an ally spends Determined to add an Opportunity, choose other allies you can influence (up to your Discipline ranks); each regains 1 focus.

talents.name: Foresight
talents.summary: You gain one extra action at the start of combat and at the start of each of your turns.

talents.name: Rallying Shout
talents.summary: Rousing Presence can target an Unconscious ally you can sense, waking them; if they're at 0 health they also heal their recovery die + your Leadership ranks.

talents.name: Seek Quarry
talents.summary: After a minute of preparation, mark a character you can sense or have met as your quarry (until you end it or choose another). You have advantage on tests to find, attack, or study your quarry.

talents.name: Tagging Shot
talents.summary: Move up to 5 ft., then make a ranged weapon attack vs. Physical. On a hit or graze the target becomes your quarry.

talents.name: Combat Training
talents.summary: Once per round, turn a missed weapon attack into a graze without spending focus. Grants one weapon expertise, one armor expertise, and Military Life.

talents.name: Sharp Eye
talents.summary: After watching your quarry briefly (or anyone for a minute), Perception vs. their Cognitive. Success reveals one: their lowest attribute, their lowest defense, or whether health, focus, or Investiture (pick one) is below half.

talents.name: Steady Aim
talents.summary: Until your turn ends, your ranged weapons' short and long ranges increase by half, and ranged hits deal extra damage equal to your Perception ranks.

talents.name: Exploit Weakness
talents.summary: Gain Advantage against your quarry as a free action.

talents.name: Backstep
talents.summary: After a ranged attack, spend 2 focus to Disengage; if you end your turn in cover or where the enemy's senses are obscured, you also get the Brace benefit.

talents.name: Unrelenting Salvo
talents.summary: You can Strike your quarry multiple times per turn with the same ranged weapon (not just once per hand).

talents.name: Hardy
talents.summary: +1 max (and current) health per character level, applied retroactively and going forward.

talents.name: Startling Blow
talents.summary: Unarmed or improvised attack vs. the Cognitive of a same-size-or-smaller target. On a hit or graze they're Surprised until the end of your next turn.

talents.name: Killing Edge
talents.summary: Gain Knives and Slings expertises; knives and slings you wield also get the Deadly and Quickdraw expert traits.

talents.name: Deadly Trap
talents.summary: Hide a 5-ft. trap within reach (max active traps = your Survival ranks). Entangling: Survival vs. Cognitive, 2d4 impact + Immobilized, then difficult terrain. Impaling: Survival vs. Physical, 2d4 keen + Afflicted vital damage, Opportunity can injure. Triggers on touch; advantage vs. your quarry; finding/disarming it is DC = your Spiritual defense.

talents.name: Animal Bond
talents.prereq_text: Have an animal companion; Seek Quarry key talent
talents.summary: Upgrades an animal companion reward: you can communicate simple ideas, it follows you, and while it's within 10 ft. all your defenses get +1. You can spend actions to have it act on your turn, and it gains a Track action. At 0 health it retreats instead of falling unconscious.

talents.name: Fatal Thrust
talents.summary: Light-weapon melee attack vs. Cognitive on a target who is Surprised, can't sense you, or doesn't see you as a threat (two advantages with a Discreet weapon). Add +4d4 damage (6d4 tier 3, 8d4 tier 4, 10d4 tier 5); every die rolling max gives −2 to their injury roll.

talents.name: Shadowing
talents.summary: Advantage to avoid your quarry's senses and they have disadvantage to sense you. When you beat an enemy's Spiritual defense from cover/obscurement, spend 3 focus to make them your quarry.

talents.name: Experienced Trapper
talents.summary: Foraging during a short rest doesn't stop you resting. You auto-succeed at foraging food and water where it exists, enough to feed characters equal to your Survival ranks.

talents.name: Protective Bond
talents.summary: Send your animal companion to guard an ally within 30 ft.; that ally gets your Animal Bond defense bonus instead of you until the scene ends or you recall it.

talents.name: Mighty
talents.summary: Weapon/unarmed hits deal +(1 + tier) damage for each action spent on that attack.

talents.name: Cold Eyes
talents.summary: When you kill or drop your quarry, regain 1 focus and immediately pick another enemy you can sense as your new quarry.

talents.name: Surefooted
talents.summary: +10 ft. movement. Damage from falling or dangerous terrain is reduced by 2 × your tier.

talents.name: Feral Connection
talents.summary: Animal companion gains +5 × tier health, +2 to all defenses, and adds your Survival ranks to its tests. Grants Animal Care expertise.

talents.name: Swift Strikes
talents.summary: Spend 1 focus to Strike a second time with a hand that already Struck this turn.

talents.name: Sidestep
talents.summary: Gain an extra action each turn (and at combat start) usable only to Dodge — only while wearing armor with deflect 1 or less.

talents.name: Hunter’s Edge
talents.summary: Your animal companion has advantage against your quarry, and your Deadly Trap damage dice and condition durations improve.

talents.name: Pack Hunting
talents.summary: Reaction when an ally in your line of effect attacks your quarry: 1 focus to add your Survival ranks to their attack result or damage.

talents.name: Decisive Command (Leader Key)
talents.summary: You gain a command die (d4, can grow to d12). Spend 1 focus: an ally within 20 ft. can roll it with their next test before their next turn ends and add it to one die (not the plot die).

talents.name: Combat Coordination
talents.summary: After you Strike, use Decisive Command as a free action — and if the Strike missed, it costs no focus.

talents.name: Valiant Intervention
talents.summary: 1 focus: move up to 10 ft., then Athletics vs. an enemy's Spiritual. Success gives them disadvantage on tests against your allies until their next turn ends; if they resist, you get advantage on your next test against them.

talents.name: Imposing Posture
talents.summary: When an enemy within your weapon's reach resists your influence, they become Disoriented until the end of their next turn.

talents.name: Hardy
talents.summary: +1 max (and current) health per character level, applied retroactively and going forward.

talents.name: Mighty
talents.summary: Weapon/unarmed hits deal +(1 + tier) damage for each action spent on that attack.

talents.name: Resolute Stand
talents.summary: Spend focus (up to your Leadership ranks) to hit that many extra targets with Valiant Intervention; anyone it affects can't make Reactive Strikes against your allies until their next turn ends.

talents.name: Resilient Hero
talents.summary: Once per scene, as a reaction to dropping to 0 health, set your health to your Athletics modifier instead.

talents.name: Demonstrative Command
talents.summary: Command die grows one size. Before an Athletics, Agility, or Leadership test, spend 1 focus to roll your command die and add it to your d20.

talents.name: Composed
talents.summary: +focus equal to your tier (max and current), growing as your tier rises.

talents.name: Through the Fray
talents.summary: An ally you can influence within 20 ft. may Disengage or Gain Advantage as a free action before your turn ends.

talents.name: Cutthroat Tactics
talents.summary: An ally about to roll your command die may raise the stakes instead; if they then roll a Complication, you regain 1 focus.

talents.name: Tactical Ploy
talents.summary: Deception vs. an enemy's Cognitive: on success they lose an action and have disadvantage on their next cognitive or spiritual test. If they resist, you get advantage on your next test against them.

talents.name: Well Supplied
talents.summary: When requisitioning or allocating resources, spend 2 focus to add an Opportunity. Grants Military Logistics expertise.

talents.name: Customary Garb
talents.summary: While visibly wearing Presentable armor or clothing suited to your station, +2 Physical and Spiritual defense.

talents.name: Rumormonger
talents.prereq_text: Have a patron; Cutthroat Tactics talent
talents.summary: When spreading misinformation or gathering rumors, spend 2 focus to add an Opportunity. Grants Scandal expertise.

talents.name: Well Dressed
talents.summary: While visibly wearing Presentable armor or fashionable clothes, gain advantage on your first Deception, Leadership, or Persuasion test each scene. Grants Fashion expertise.

talents.name: Relentless March
talents.summary: An ally you give Decisive Command to gets +10 ft. movement and ignores Exhausted, Slowed, and Surprised until their next turn ends.

talents.name: Confident Command
talents.summary: Command die grows one size. Before an Intimidation, Leadership, or Persuasion test, spend 1 focus to roll your command die and add it to your d20.

talents.name: Baleful
talents.summary: Anyone resisting your influence must pay extra focus equal to your tier.

talents.name: Set at Odds
talents.summary: Spend 1 focus per target (2+) you can influence and name a source of friction, then Leadership vs. their highest Spiritual. Success turns them against each other until they resolve it; resisters lose extra focus equal to your Leadership ranks.

talents.name: Synchronized Assault
talents.summary: 2 focus: Leadership vs. an enemy's Cognitive. Success lets allies (up to your Leadership ranks) each gain a bonus action on their next turn usable only to Strike that enemy; failure still gives it to one ally.

talents.name: Authority
talents.prereq_text: Have a title granting you command over at least 5 people; Confident Command talent
requires_other: Have a title granting you command over at least 5 people
talents.summary: Your ally-affecting Leader talents get double range and can affect twice as many allies.

talents.name: Shrewd Command
talents.summary: Command die grows one size. Before a Deception, Insight, or Leadership test, spend 1 focus to roll your command die and add it to your d20.

talents.name: Grand Deception
talents.summary: 3 focus, DC 15 Deception: reveal that a detail you set up since the last scene began was secretly a ruse. It must be plausible; the GM decides.

talents.name: Erudition (Scholar Key)
talents.summary: Pick one cultural/utility expertise and two non-surge cognitive skills: you count as having that expertise and +1 rank in each skill (can exceed max; doesn't count for prerequisites). Swap them after a long rest with library access.

talents.name: Efficient Engineer
talents.summary: Gain Armor, Equipment, or Weapon Crafting expertise and a starting fabrial (amplifying painrial, numbing painrial, or spanreed pair + emotion bracelet). Crafting tests get Opportunity range +2 and half material costs.

talents.name: Prized Acquisition
talents.summary: Gain Fabrial Crafting expertise and a special gem that powers a unique fabrial of your current tier. The first fabrial skips the usual spren/crafting time; you can salvage and reuse the gem.

talents.name: Deep Study
talents.summary: Erudition grants one more cultural/utility expertise and two more cognitive skills.

talents.name: Inventive Design
talents.summary: Fabrials built with your Prized Acquisition gem can use effects one tier higher than you'd normally craft.

talents.name: Fine Handiwork
talents.summary: When crafting, an advanced feature costs one upgrade instead of two (once per item).

talents.name: Overcharge
talents.summary: Once per turn, raise the stakes on a fabrial attack. An Opportunity gives an extra Strike with that fabrial; a Complication adds a drawback until you fix it (DC 15 Crafting).

talents.name: Experimental Tinkering
talents.summary: Crafting tests get Opportunity range +1 and take half the time. You can give up a long rest's benefits to rebuild your Prized Acquisition fabrial into a different fabrial of the same tier or lower, no new materials needed.

talents.name: Overwhelm with Details
talents.summary: Spend 2 focus to use your Lore modifier for any cognitive or spiritual test.

talents.name: Strategize
talents.summary: After a successful Gain Advantage using an Erudition skill, give the benefit to an ally instead; spend 2 focus to also stop the target using reactions against that ally until your next turn ends.

talents.name: Mind and Body
talents.summary: Erudition grants one extra skill and can now pick physical (non-surge) skills. Gain a weapon expertise.

talents.name: Field Medicine
talents.summary: 1 focus, DC 15 Medicine on a conscious, willing character in reach (disadvantage on yourself). They heal their recovery die + your Medicine ranks on a success, or just the recovery die on a failure.

talents.name: Emotional Intelligence
talents.summary: Erudition grants one extra skill and can now pick spiritual (non-surge) skills. Gain Diagnosis expertise.

talents.name: Anatomical Insight
talents.summary: When your unarmed attack hits a same-size-or-smaller target, spend 1 focus or an Opportunity to make them Exhausted (penalty = half your Medicine ranks, rounded up).

talents.name: Collected
talents.summary: +2 to both Cognitive and Spiritual defense.

talents.name: Composed
talents.summary: +focus equal to your tier (max and current), growing as your tier rises.

talents.name: Know Your Moment
talents.summary: From the start of each round until your turn begins, all your defenses are +2.

talents.name: Swift Healer
talents.summary: Field Medicine becomes a free action, and all your healing of others restores extra health equal to your Medicine ranks.

talents.name: Applied Medicine
talents.summary: Whenever you heal a character, they recover extra health equal to your Lore ranks.

talents.name: Deep Contemplation
talents.summary: Reassign up to 2 of your Erudition skills/expertises on the spot.

talents.name: Keen Insight
talents.summary: After a successful Gain Advantage, the target has disadvantage on their next test this encounter unless they resist your influence.

talents.name: Ongoing Care
talents.summary: Give up a rest's benefits to treat an ally; then DC 10 Medicine (+5 per extra injury) removes one condition caused by an injury (not the injury). Once per 24 hours per patient. Grants Mental Health Care expertise.

talents.name: Resuscitation
talents.summary: Field Medicine for 3 focus can target someone Unconscious or dead for no more rounds than your Medicine ranks (DC +5 per extra injury). Success heals them and brings the dead back to life.

talents.name: Contingency
talents.summary: Reaction when an ally within 20 ft. rolls a Complication: spend 2 focus to remove it.

talents.name: Turning Point
talents.summary: Once per scene, 2 focus: Deduction vs. the enemy leader's Cognitive (advantage if you took a slow turn). Success gives you and your allies an extra action on your next turns.

talents.name: Vigilant Stance (Warrior Key)
talents.summary: You learn stances and start with Vigilant Stance: Dodge and Reactive Strike cost 1 less focus, and from it you can switch into other stances as a free action. Stances last until you change or end them, or the scene ends; combat only by default.

talents.name: Practiced Kata
talents.summary: You can use stances in conversations and endeavors (1 focus, counts as your contribution), and you start any scene in Vigilant Stance unless Surprised.

talents.name: Flamestance
talents.summary: Stance: advantage on Intimidation. While you and exactly one enemy are alone in each other's reach, you can gain a bonus action usable only to attack it or Gain Advantage.

talents.name: Ironstance
talents.summary: Stance: advantage on Insight. When someone in your reach misses or grazes you, you can Reactive Strike them as though they'd left your reach.

talents.name: Signature Weapon
talents.summary: Gain a weapon expertise; pick one weapon type you're expert in — your Opportunity range with it expands by 1 (by 2 from tier 3).

talents.name: Surefooted
talents.summary: +10 ft. movement. Damage from falling or dangerous terrain is reduced by 2 × your tier.

talents.name: Feinting Strike
talents.summary: 2 focus: melee weapon attack vs. Cognitive. A hit costs the target an action and focus equal to your Intimidation ranks; a graze costs half that focus. An Opportunity gives you an action usable only to Strike or change stance.

talents.name: Vinestance
talents.summary: Stance: +1 Physical and Cognitive defense. After being hit or grazed in melee, react with Athletics vs. the attacker's Cognitive; success drains 1d4 focus and pushes them up to 5 ft. × your Athletics ranks.

talents.name: Wit’s End
talents.summary: 1 focus: move up to half your movement, then melee attack vs. Cognitive on a target with 0 focus. Ignores deflect, can't graze, +4d6 damage (6d6/8d6/10d6 at tiers 3/4/5).

talents.name: Shard Training
talents.prereq_text: Access to a Shardblade and Shardplate for training; Vigilant Stance key talent
requires_other: Access to a Shardblade and Shardplate for training
talents.summary: Gain Shardplate expertise and one of Grandbow/Shardblade/Warhammer. Your Shardplate gets +2 charges. Once per round, a Shardblade Strike also grazes extra enemies in reach (up to your skill ranks) whose Physical defense your roll meets.

talents.name: Stonestance
talents.summary: Stance: +1 deflect. Enemies in your melee reach must spend an extra action to attack your allies who aren't in Stonestance.

talents.name: Cautious Advance
talents.summary: Move up to half your movement ignoring difficult terrain, then gain an action usable only to Brace or Gain Advantage.

talents.name: Combat Training
talents.summary: Once per round, turn a missed weapon attack into a graze without spending focus. Grants one weapon expertise, one armor expertise, and Military Life.

talents.name: Defensive Position
talents.summary: Brace gives attackers two disadvantages instead of one, and when you Brace with a shield, allies within 5 ft. can Brace as if they had cover.

talents.name: Devastating Blow
talents.summary: Melee weapon attack vs. Physical with +2d8 damage (3d8/4d8/5d8 at tiers 3/4/5).

talents.name: Windstance
talents.summary: Stance: advantage on Agility. While two or more enemies are in your reach, you can gain a bonus action usable only to Disengage or attack them.

talents.name: Mighty
talents.summary: Weapon/unarmed hits deal +(1 + tier) damage for each action spent on that attack.

talents.name: Formation Drills
talents.summary: Allies within 10 ft. who Brace also benefit from your Defensive Position.

talents.name: Hardy
talents.summary: +1 max (and current) health per character level, applied retroactively and going forward.

talents.name: Shattering Blow
talents.summary: On a melee hit with a two-handed weapon or a free hand, spend 2 focus: armor with charges (e.g. Shardplate) loses 1, and everyone damaged is shoved 5 ft. (+5 ft. per Strength above 5), taking fall damage if they slam into something.

talents.name: Bloodstance
talents.prereq_text: Athletics 2+; Mighty talent or Shard Training talent
talents.summary: Stance: Opportunity range on attacks and physical tests expands by 2, but all three defenses drop by 2.

talents.name: Wary
talents.summary: You can't be Surprised while you have any focus, and whenever you lose focus involuntarily or by resisting influence, lose your Discipline ranks less (minimum 1).

talents.name: Swift Strikes
talents.summary: Spend 1 focus to Strike a second time with a hand that already Struck this turn.

talents.name: Precise Parry
talents.summary: Reaction before a melee hit lands, 1 focus: test your weapon skill (or Athletics unarmed, with disadvantage unless vs. a Shardblade) against the attack result; success turns it into a graze. Opportunities can disarm (unarmed) or shatter mundane weapons (with a Shardblade).

talents.name: Meteoric Leap
talents.summary: 2 focus: leap up to a quarter of your movement, then unarmed attack vs. Physical against any chosen characters in reach, rolling double damage dice; hit targets with lower Strength fall Prone. Advantage while in Shardplate.

talents.name: First Ideal (Dustbringer Key)
talents.summary: Requires level 2+. Gain Investiture (max = 2 + the higher of Awareness or Presence) and the Breathe Stormlight, Enhance, and Regenerate actions, plus the goal “Speak the First Ideal.” Completing it makes you Empowered for the scene and grants the Abrasion and Division surge skills at 1 rank each.

talents.name: Second Ideal (Dustbringer)
talents.summary: Gain the goal “Speak the Second Ideal.” On completion you're Empowered for the scene, and from then on, while you hold any Investiture, Enhance is a free action that costs no Investiture to use or maintain.

talents.name: Searing Dust Storm
talents.summary: When you Move along a solid surface, spend 1+ Investiture to leave an obscuring dust cloud in spaces you pass through (lasts 1 round per Investiture, or until wind clears it). The first damage each enemy in it takes each round is increased by your Discipline ranks.

talents.name: Third Ideal (Dustbringer)
talents.summary: Gain the goal “Speak the Third Ideal.” On completion you're Empowered for the scene and can manifest your spren as a Radiant Shardblade.

talents.name: Invested
talents.summary: Max Investiture increases by your tier (and keeps pace as your tier rises).

talents.summary: Use Tension on a liquid (up to twice your normal Tension area) to stiffen its surface so people can walk on it like ground.

talents.name: Unbound Cohesion
talents.summary: Cohesion and its talents work on any solid, non-living, non-Invested material that isn't infused — not just stone.

talents.name: Flowing Earth
talents.summary: After using Cohesion (or spending an action on a Cohesion talent), the stone under you carries you up to 5 ft. × your Cohesion ranks in any direction, free and without provoking Reactive Strikes.

talents.name: Fine Control
talents.summary: Infuse 1+ Investiture into an unattended soft object you can Tension: it gets health (5 × Tension ranks) and defenses (10 + Tension modifier). While touching it you can slide it 25 ft. along any surface and spend actions to have it do tasks or attack (Tension vs. Physical, 2d4 impact, dice scale).

talents.name: Clothsmith
talents.prereq_text: Cloth Mastery talent or Surface Tension talent
talents.summary: Hardened Defense grants +4 Physical defense instead of +2, and weapons you make with Tension add an extra d4 damage die (scales with Tension ranks).

talents.name: First Ideal (Truthwatcher Key)
talents.summary: Requires level 2+. Gain Investiture (max = 2 + the higher of Awareness or Presence) and the Breathe Stormlight, Enhance, and Regenerate actions, plus the goal “Speak the First Ideal.” Completing it makes you Empowered for the scene and grants the Illumination and Progression surge skills at 1 rank each.

talents.name: Second Ideal (Truthwatcher)
talents.summary: Gain the goal “Speak the Second Ideal.” On completion you're Empowered for the scene, and from then on, while you hold any Investiture, Enhance is a free action that costs no Investiture to use or maintain.

talents.name: Spiritual Healing
talents.prereq_text: Illumination 2+; Progression 2+; Speak the First Ideal
talents.summary: When you'd heal yourself or a willing ally, you can pay 2 Investiture to have them recover focus equal to half that healing (round up) instead.

talents.name: Third Ideal (Truthwatcher)
talents.summary: Gain the goal “Speak the Third Ideal.” On completion you're Empowered for the scene and can manifest your spren as a Radiant Shardblade.

talents.name: Invested
talents.summary: Max Investiture increases by your tier (and keeps pace as your tier rises).

talents.name: Fourth Ideal (Truthwatcher)
talents.summary: Gain the goal “Speak the Fourth Ideal.” On completion you're Empowered for the scene and can manifest Radiant Shardplate (a swarm of concentrationspren).

talents.name: Wound Regeneration
talents.summary: When you Regenerate, you can also (or instead) cure an injury: 2 Investiture for a temporary injury, 3 for a permanent one.

talents.name: Deepened Bond
talents.summary: Spren bond range grows from 30 ft. to 100 ft., and giving your spren a task costs 1 less focus (minimum 1).

talents.name: Take Squire (Truthwatcher)
talents.summary: After a long rest, take a willing, sapient companion or PC you've known for at least one session (and who has no Radiant spren) as a squire, sharing none, one, or both surges. Max squires = the number of your current Ideal.

talents.name: Distracting Illusion
talents.summary: 1 Investiture: an illusory double overlaps you or an ally within spren bond range. Attacks against them have disadvantage and can't graze until one misses (or the scene ends).

talents.name: Lingering Lightweavings
talents.summary: You can anchor an illusion's Investiture in a sphere or gem within 5 ft.; the illusion moves with the gem (an ally can carry it) and only drains 1 Investiture every X rounds, where X = your Illumination ranks.

talents.name: Injury Regrowth
talents.summary: Touch yourself or a willing character: 2 Investiture heals a temporary injury of their choice, 3 Investiture a permanent one.

talents.name: Explosive Growth
talents.summary: 1 Investiture: Growth erupts across an area (up to your Progression size); one Progression attack vs. the Physical of each chosen character, 2d4 impact or keen (dice scale). An Opportunity Immobilizes those hit until your next turn ends.

talents.name: Disorienting Flash
talents.summary: 1 Investiture: a burst of light fills an area in reach (up to your Illumination size); one Illumination test vs. each character's Cognitive Disorients them until their next turn ends.

talents.name: Stormlight Reclamation
talents.summary: After your infusions drain at the start of your turn, end any number within reach and get back their remaining Investiture.

talents.name: Swift Regeneration
talents.summary: When you Regenerate, you may heal 1d6 + your Progression modifier instead (die grows at 3+ ranks). While you have Investiture, you and anyone with your Regrowth add your Progression modifier to injury rolls.

talents.name: Overgrowth
talents.summary: When infusing Growth into a plant, a DC 15 Progression test lets it exceed its species' limits (up to your surge size) and gain 2d4 health (dice scale).

talents.name: Spiritual Illumination
talents.summary: 2 Investiture: a brief Lightweaving makes an ally within spren bond range Determined and Focused until their next turn ends.

talents.name: Multiplicative Lightweaving
talents.summary: When you Lightweave, create extra illusions (up to your Illumination ranks) at no extra Investiture; they last as long as the original.

talents.name: Extended Regrowth
talents.summary: Your Regrowth infusions only drain 1 Investiture every X rounds, where X = your Progression ranks.

talents.name: Reliable Progression
talents.summary: When a Progression-scaled die (or a Regrowth healing die) rolls below your Progression ranks, you can treat it as equal to your ranks.

talents.name: Painful Truth
talents.summary: 2 Investiture: Illumination vs. the Spiritual of someone within spren bond range. On success they're Slowed, and on their next turn they must pay focus equal to your Illumination ranks or flee from you as far as they can.

talents.name: Endless Illusions
talents.prereq_text: Multiplicative Lightweaving talent or Spiritual Illumination talent
talents.summary: While you have any Investiture, Illumination infusions within your spren bond range don't drain.

talents.name: From the Brink
talents.summary: 3 Investiture: touch someone who died within the last minute; if willing, they return to life Unconscious at 0 health.

talents.name: Font of Life
talents.prereq_text: Extended Regrowth talent or Reliable Progression talent
talents.summary: Progression and its talents cost one fewer action.

talents.summary: Gain the goal “Speak the Second Ideal.” On completion you're Empowered for the scene, and from then on, while you hold any Investiture, Enhance is a free action that costs no Investiture to use or maintain.

talents.name: Spiritual Cohesion
talents.summary: Once per scene, make allies you can influence (up to your current Ideal number) Determined for the scene; anyone who spends it gets +2 Cognitive and Spiritual defense for the rest of the scene.

talents.name: Third Ideal (Willshaper)
talents.summary: Gain the goal “Speak the Third Ideal.” On completion you're Empowered for the scene and can manifest your spren as a Radiant Shardblade.

talents.summary: Max Investiture increases by your tier (and keeps pace as your tier rises).

talents.name: Cognitive Farsight
talents.summary: When peering into Shadesmar with Transportation, you can see out to 3 × your spren bond range. While holding Investiture you always know north and the way to the nearest settlement.

talents.name: Realmic Evasion
talents.summary: Reaction before you're hit, 1 Investiture: Transportation test vs. the attack result (decide after seeing it). Fail = graze instead; success = clean miss.

talents.name: Stone Spear
talents.summary: 1 Investiture: ranged Cohesion attack vs. Physical within 60 ft., 2d4 impact (dice scale); an Opportunity knocks the target Prone.

talents.name: Memories of Stone
talents.summary: 1 Investiture: talk to the stone you're touching for 1 round — it knows local history and recent events but answers in cryptic images and whispers (GM may call for Cohesion to interpret).

talents.name: Sinkhole
talents.summary: 1 Investiture: soften stone ground in an area (up to your Cohesion size); one Cohesion test vs. the Cognitive of each chosen character standing there sinks them in and leaves them Immobilized.

talents.name: Tunneling
talents.summary: 1 Investiture: move through stone as difficult terrain, leaving a 5-ft. tunnel others can follow. Maintain with 1 Investiture each turn.

talents.name: Cognitive Vision
talents.summary: Peering into Shadesmar adds two options: Learn Intent (Transportation vs. an enemy's Cognitive; reveal their likely plan and give them disadvantage on their next test vs. your side) and Locate Objects (read the soul beads to learn about nearby objects).

talents.name: Realmic Step
talents.summary: DC 15 Transportation, then 2 Investiture (1 over a large body of water): step through Shadesmar to an unoccupied space you can sense within spren bond range. No Reactive Strikes.

talents.name: Through the Stone
talents.summary: Use your surges and surge talents at 20 ft. reach, as long as a stone surface you can touch connects you to the target.

talents.name: True Stoneshaping
talents.summary: Cohesion-shaped stone takes any form you like instantly — walls, pillars, terrain, intricate carvings — with no extra actions or time.

talents.name: Shared Transportation
talents.summary: When you travel through Shadesmar with Elsecalling or Realmic Step, bring willing characters in reach for 1 Investiture each.

talents.name: Elsecalling
talents.prereq_text: Speak the Third Ideal; Realmic Step talent
talents.summary: Shift yourself (and your gear) between the Physical and Cognitive Realms at the same location, with no Reactive Strikes. Into Shadesmar: 1 Investiture, no test. Back out: DC 20 Transportation, then 2 Investiture (retry on later turns if you fail).

talents.summary: Cohesion and its talents work on any solid, non-living, non-Invested material that isn't infused — not just stone.

talents.name: Elsegate
talents.prereq_text: Speak the Fourth Ideal; Shared Transportation talent
talents.summary: After a long rest, teleport yourself and up to ten willing companions to an Oathgate or permanent perpendicularity you've visited. Needs infused spheres worth 2 marks per traveller, which all go dun.

talents.name: Realmwalker
talents.summary: Transportation tests for Transportation talents succeed automatically.

talents.summary: Gain the goal “Speak the Second Ideal.” On completion you're Empowered for the scene, and from then on, while you hold any Investiture, Enhance is a free action that costs no Investiture to use or maintain.

talents.name: Reverse Lashing
talents.summary: Instead of a Basic Lashing, give yourself or an object a Reverse Lashing and name an object type (“projectiles”, “keys”…). Matching unattended objects within your gravitation rate fly to it and stick — which can pull ranged attacks off course.

talents.name: Flying Ace
talents.summary: While Lashed, fly up to your gravitation rate (now permanently 40 ft.); once during the flight, spend 1 focus to make a melee weapon attack and keep flying.

talents.name: Gravitational Slam
talents.summary: Lashing an unwilling target into a solid surface deals 1d4 impact per 10 ft. it moved this turn (dice scale). They can Avoid Danger (Agility vs. your Gravitation) to halve it.

talents.name: Stormlight Reclamation
talents.summary: After your infusions drain at the start of your turn, end any number within reach and get back their remaining Investiture.

talents.name: Binding Strike
talents.summary: After a melee hit, spend an Opportunity or 2 focus to Full Lash something the target holds or wears to another object/surface within 5 ft. — no action, automatic success.

talents.name: Distant Surgebinding
talents.summary: Use your surges and surge talents at 20 ft. reach without touching (Full Lashed objects still have to be within 5 ft. of each other).

talents.name: Binding Shot
talents.summary: Binding Strike also works on ranged hits at any distance, no touch or free hand needed.

talents.name: Stable Flight
talents.summary: While Lashed yourself, flying or unstable footing never imposes disadvantage on your ranged attacks.

talents.name: Multiple Lashings
talents.summary: After moving an unwilling character with Gravitation, infuse them with up to your Gravitation ranks in Investiture so the effect lasts until the infusion runs out.

talents.name: Extended Adhesion
talents.summary: Full Lashings only drain 1 Investiture every X rounds, where X = your Adhesion ranks.

talents.name: Adhesive Trap
talents.summary: Infuse Adhesion into a patch of surface instead of two objects; anyone who touches it (or is shoved into it) is automatically Full Lashed to it while it lasts.

talents.name: Group Flight
talents.summary: Outside combat, a Basic Lashing on yourself or a willing ally can also Lash extra willing characters in reach (up to your Gravitation ranks) for no extra Investiture.

talents.name: Lashing Shot
talents.summary: Hurl an unattended object you can Lash at a target in line of effect, paying Investiture = distance ÷ gravitation rate (round up). Ranged Gravitation attack vs. Physical, 2d4 impact (dice scale).

talents.name: Living Adhesion
talents.summary: You can Lash characters directly. Lashed to something larger than them, they're Restrained, have disadvantage on physical tests, and attacks against them gain advantage.

talents.name: Superior Bond
talents.prereq_text: Adhesive Trap talent or Extended Adhesion talent
talents.summary: Anyone trying to break your Full Lashing automatically fails if their Strength is no higher than your Adhesion ranks.

talents.name: Aerial Squadron
talents.summary: Group Flight now works in combat.

talents.name: Master of the Skies
talents.prereq_text: Group Flight talent or Lashing Shot talent
talents.summary: While you have any Investiture, you count as infused with Gravitation without paying for it.

talents.name: Future Sight (Enlightened Key)
talents.summary: After a rest or at the start of a scene, ask the GM for a vision of an important near-future event; the GM may call for Deduction to interpret it, and a Complication may secretly make it false. Unlocks the rest of this tree once you speak the First Ideal.

talents.name: Glimpse the Future
talents.prereq_text: Speak the First Ideal; Future Sight key talent
talents.summary: Once per round after rolling a test, spend Investiture to reroll that many of its dice (new results stand).

talents.name: Search the Past
talents.prereq_text: Speak the First Ideal; Future Sight key talent
talents.summary: After a long rest, choose a past event you know of and test Lore (DC by how long ago: 10 for a day up to 35 for 10,000 years; −10 if you've witnessed it). Success gives you a 10-minute vision of it as an invisible, intangible observer.

talents.name: Alter Fortune
talents.summary: After each long rest, roll and record 1 + tier d20s. As a reaction, replace the d20 of any enemy or willing ally test you can sense with a recorded number (after seeing the roll, before effects).

talents.name: Vision Void
talents.prereq_text: Glimpse the Future talent or Search the Past talent
talents.summary: Enemies can't reroll or replace dice for you or allies within your spren bond range, and no enemy can see visions (past or future) of events you're part of.

talents.name: Change Form (Singer Key)
talents.summary: Outdoors in a highstorm, bond a spren to change form: dullform (can pass as a “parshman”, no bonuses), mateform, or any form you've unlocked. A form's bonuses (even above normal maximums) last until you change again; one form at a time.

talents.name: Forms of Finesse
talents.summary: Unlocks artform (Awareness +1, Painting and Music expertises, advantage on Crafting and entertaining) and nimbleform (Speed +1, +2 max and current focus while in form).

talents.name: Forms of Resolve
talents.summary: Unlocks warform (Strength +1, deflect +1 that doesn't stack with armor, big jumps without Athletics tests) and workform (Willpower +1, ignore Exhausted, can pass as a “parshman”).

talents.name: Forms of Wisdom
talents.summary: Unlocks mediationform (Presence +1, Aid costs no focus) and scholarform (Intellect +1, a temporary cultural/utility expertise and +1 rank in a non-surge cognitive skill; interacts with Erudition).

talents.name: Ambitious Mind
talents.prereq_text: Discipline 3+; either the Forms of Finesse, Forms of Resolve, or Forms of Wisdom talent
talents.summary: +2 Cognitive defense; opens the door to Voidspren forms of power. While Voidspren-bonded, once per day a Complication forces a DC 15 Discipline test or you're Stunned until your next turn ends (auto-pass if you've sworn a First Ideal).

talents.name: Forms of Destruction
talents.summary: Unlocks direform (Strength +2, deflect +2, Reactive Strikes can Grapple instead) and stormform (Strength +1, Speed +1, deflect +1, Unleash Lightning: 1 focus or Investiture, ranged Discipline attack vs. Physical at 60 ft., 2d8 energy and Disoriented; dice grow with Discipline).

talents.name: Forms of Expansion
talents.summary: Unlocks envoyform (Intellect +1, Presence +1, understand all languages, advantage on Insight about intentions) and relayform (Speed +2, ignore Slowed, 1 focus for advantage on Agility/Stealth/Thievery).

talents.name: Forms of Mystery
talents.summary: Unlocks decayform (Willpower +2; Decaying Touch: 1 focus or Investiture to stop a character in reach from recovering health or focus) and nightform (Awareness +1, Intellect +1, +2 focus; pre-roll two d20s each session to replace enemy/ally rolls, plus random GM premonitions).

steps.title: Origins
steps.body: Pick an ancestry (human or singer) and up to two cultural expertises. Your ancestry grants bonus talent(s), chosen in step 5.

steps.title: Starting path
steps.body: Choose one heroic path: Agent, Envoy, Hunter, Leader, Scholar, or Warrior. You'll gain its starting skill rank and key talent. Radiant paths open from level 2.

steps.title: Attributes
steps.body: Spread 12 points across Strength, Speed, Intellect, Willpower, Awareness, and Presence, max 3 in any one. Then note lifting capacity (STR), movement (SPD), recovery die (WIL), and senses range (AWA).

steps.title: Skills and expertises
steps.body: Take 1 free rank in your path's starting skill, then 4 more ranks anywhere (max 2 per skill at level 1). Skill modifier = ranks + linked attribute. Add expertises equal to your Intellect on top of your two cultural ones.

steps.title: Talents
steps.body: Take your path's key talent. Humans add one more heroic-path talent; singers take Change Form plus one forms talent.

steps.title: Equipment
steps.body: Choose a starting kit, optionally spend its marks, and record your armor's deflect value.

steps.title: Story
steps.body: Pick a purpose (what drives you) and at least one obstacle (what holds you back), then one or two goals with your GM. Sketch connections, personality, and appearance, and a possible Radiant order if you want one.

steps.title: Final calculations
steps.body: Health = 10 + STR. Focus = 2 + WIL. Physical defense = 10 + STR + SPD; Cognitive = 10 + INT + WIL; Spiritual = 10 + AWA + PRE. Level 1, no Investiture yet.

ancestries.name: Human
points: At level 1 (step 5) take one bonus talent from any heroic path — another from your own path, or the key talent of a second path.
Gain another heroic-path bonus talent at each new tier: levels 6, 11, 16, and 21.

ancestries.name: Singer
points: You can take talents from the Singer tree (see the Singer tab).
At level 1 you gain Change Form plus one of Forms of Finesse, Resolve, or Wisdom, and choose your starting form.
At levels 6, 11, 16, and 21, take a bonus talent from the Singer tree or any heroic path.
Forms change only during a highstorm; form bonuses are temporary and don't count toward prerequisites.

cultures: Alethi
War-driven monarchy of highprinces. You know the princedoms, a regional dialect, Vorin basics, and glyphs; literacy depends on your gender norms.
Azish
Bureaucratic empire of viziers and the Prime Aqasix. You know its procedures, member states, and civic buildings; Azish sign, speech, and script.
Herdazian
Ranching kingdom with a large diaspora. You know the major families, ranch routes, sparkflickers, and personal Vorinism.
Iriali
Golden-skinned people of the One and the Long Trail, ruled by a triumvirate. You know their faith, a home city or region, and travel logistics.
Kharbranthian
City of Bells: hospitals, the Palanaeum, trade. You know its education system, common medicines, and hygiene against rotspren.
Listener
Singers of the Shattered Plains (needs singer ancestry or GM permission). You know the five pre-Everstorm forms, the Five, the songs, and the War of Reckoning.
Natan
Remnant of a lost empire near the Ocean of Origins. You know full-strength highstorms and how to shelter from them.
Reshi
Island monarchies on roaming greatshells. You know Tai-na lore, the Reshi Sea, and their quick, fierce arguments.
Shin
Stone Shamans, sacred stone, mild storms. You know Shin ecology, barter customs, and Stone Shamanism.
Thaylen
Merchant island nation with an elected monarch. You know the councils, artifabrian guilds, fabrials, and sea travel.
Unkalaki
Horneater Peaks and their warm crater lakes. You're used to thin air and know their spren-gods and lake lore.
Veden
Jah Keved: king, highprinces, four ethnic groups. You know the princedoms, Vorin church affairs, and glyphs.
Wayfarer
A life on the road. You read international maps, find honest money-changers, and know greetings from many lands.
Other (GM approval)
Other nations or subcultures such as High Society, Military Life, or Underworld.
tiers: Personal stakes; you may start attracting a spren.
Higher stakes; Ideals sworn, Shardblades possible.
Threats to all of Roshar; Fused, Shardplate.
Legends: lead the fight or retire in peace.

goals_rules: Each goal has three milestone boxes. The GM ticks one when you meaningfully advance it — usually at most once per session.
With three milestones you can conclude the goal when the moment is right: by success, by growing past it, or even by failure.
Concluding a goal earns a reward: a companion, a fabrial or high-quality gem, an Ideal, a patron, Shards, or a title.
Radiant Ideals are goals too, but they come from your Ideal talents rather than the GM.

radiant_rules: From level 2 you can take an order's First Ideal key talent. It grants Investiture right away and the goal “Speak the First Ideal”; the order's two surges unlock when you complete it.
Max = 2 + the higher of Awareness or Presence. Works like focus. You start most scenes full if you carry marks worth 3× your Investiture (only 1 if Surprised).
Draw Stormlight from infused spheres within 5 ft. to refill Investiture. Usable while Unconscious.
1 Investiture: Enhanced +1 Strength and +1 Speed until the end of your next turn; maintain for 1 Investiture each turn.
Free action, 1 Investiture: heal 1d6 + tier. Usable while Unconscious.

Each Ideal is a goal with three milestones earned by living your order's philosophy. When you speak the Words you become Empowered for the scene (advantage on all tests, Investiture refills each turn) and unlock the talent's reward. Fifth Ideals aren't available.
First lapse: nothing. Repeat lapses before you've made amends strip your highest Ideal and the talents that depend on it, one Ideal at a time. Rededicate yourself to repair the bond.
From the Third Ideal (Take Squire), trusted allies within 50 miles get Investiture 2, the Stormlight actions, and optionally 1 rank in your surges.

No stat block. Moves at your speed and must stay within spren bond range (30 ft.). Covert Scouting (2 focus), Oath Encouragement (2 focus), Sudden Warning (3 focus), Translation (2 focus), plus order-specific abilities.
surge_rules: Infusions drain 1 Investiture at the start of each of your turns until empty; infusing yourself draws from your own pool.
Surge attacks: add your surge modifier to damage on a hit; spend 1 focus per target to graze on a miss.
Outside combat, one “round” of a surge is about a minute in conversations and about 10 minutes outside scenes.
With GM approval you can attempt creative uses beyond the listed ones.
surges: Skate: spend 2 focus to Move in a straight line as if on ice. Slide: count as one size smaller when squeezing, and get advantage escaping friction-based bonds.
Full Lashing: touch two unsecured objects within 5 ft. of each other (one can be a surface) and infuse 1+ Investiture to stick them together. Not usable on characters or Invested/infused items.
Infuse unattended stone in reach to make it soft as clay; it re-hardens in its new shape when the infusion ends.
Touch to decay. Characters: 1 Investiture, melee Division attack vs. Spiritual, 3d4 spirit; at 0 health they crumble to dust. Objects/areas: Investiture by size, with a test under pressure.

Basic Lashing: infuse a character or object you touch to change its gravity. Willing targets (or you) gain a flying rate equal to your gravitation rate (starts at 25 ft.); objects fall your rate each turn.
Lightweave a sight-and-sound illusion within spren bond range; simple ones drain every 10 minutes, complex ones every round. A disguise on yourself is free while you hold Investiture.
Growth: 1 Investiture makes a plant grow rapidly. Regrowth: infuse a living character to heal 1d4 + Progression modifier at the start of each of their turns.
Infuse soft material in reach to make it rigid (shape it roughly as you do). Hardened Defense: stiffened clothing grants +2 Physical defense.
Soulcast a non-living object you touch into another material; the DC grows with how different the materials are (solids, organics, liquids, vapors, clear air).
Spend Investiture to peer into Shadesmar within spren bond range: read emotions and motives from spren, locate people by their flames, or sense Investiture.
